note.en: Aguirre gives Mexico a pragmatic tournament shape, with compact defending, fast counters, and enough attacking freedom for the front line to improvise.
note.zh: 阿吉雷让墨西哥呈现务实的大赛形态：防守紧凑、反击迅速，同时给锋线足够自由去即兴创造。

history.en: Back for a third spell with Mexico, he brings long international and club experience from Mexico, Spain, Japan, Egypt, and Mallorca.
history.zh: 这是他第三次执教墨西哥，他带来在墨西哥、西班牙、日本、埃及以及马略卡长期执教的国家队和俱乐部经验。

note.en: Broos favors a disciplined South Africa block, asking his side to protect central spaces before breaking quickly through direct runners.
note.zh: 布鲁斯偏好纪律严明的南非防守阵型，要求球队先保护中路空间，再依靠直接跑动快速反击。

history.en: Appointed in 2021, he rebuilt Bafana Bafana around a younger core after previously winning the Africa Cup of Nations with Cameroon in 2017.
history.zh: 他于2021年上任，此前曾带领喀麦隆赢得2017年非洲杯，随后围绕更年轻的核心重建南非队。

note.en: Hong leans on defensive order and controlled transitions, using South Korea's athletic midfield to press in bursts rather than chase every phase.
note.zh: 洪明甫依靠防守秩序和可控转换，利用韩国队运动能力强的中场进行阶段性压迫，而不是每个阶段都盲目追抢。

history.en: A former national-team captain and 2012 Olympic bronze-medal coach, he returned to the South Korea job in 2024.
history.zh: 他曾是韩国队队长，并作为主教练带队获得2012年奥运会铜牌，2024年重返韩国队帅位。

note.en: Koubek sets Czechia up with a coach's eye for structure: compact lines, physical pressure, and quick service into attacking zones.
note.zh: 库贝克以重视结构的教练视角打造捷克队：阵线紧凑、身体压迫强，并快速把球送入进攻区域。

history.en: A veteran Czech manager, he has led top-flight clubs including Viktoria Plzen and brings decades of domestic experience to the national setup.
history.zh: 他是经验丰富的捷克教练，曾执教比尔森胜利等顶级联赛球队，把数十年的本土执教经验带入国家队体系。

note.en: Marsch wants Canada to play on the front foot, pressing aggressively and turning recoveries into quick vertical attacks.
note.zh: 马什希望加拿大主动出击，高强度压迫，并把夺回球权后的瞬间转化为快速纵向进攻。

history.en: Appointed in 2024, he arrived after senior jobs with New York Red Bulls, Salzburg, Leipzig, Leeds United, and Canada's new-era program.
history.zh: 他于2024年上任，此前执教过纽约红牛、萨尔茨堡、莱比锡、利兹联，并参与加拿大新周期建设。

note.en: Barbarez gives Bosnia and Herzegovina a possession-minded but emotionally direct identity, with midfield control feeding early forward runs.
note.zh: 巴尔巴雷兹让波黑兼具控球思路和直接冲击的气质，用中场控制去支撑锋线更早的前插。

history.en: A former national-team star, he took the Bosnia and Herzegovina job in 2024 after a long playing career in Germany.
history.zh: 他曾是波黑国家队球星，在德国拥有漫长球员生涯，并于2024年接手波黑队。

note.en: Pochettino brings a high-energy United States model built around pressing triggers, brave fullbacks, and quick support around the ball.
note.zh: 波切蒂诺为美国队带来高能量模式，核心是明确的压迫触发点、敢于前插的边后卫，以及围绕持球点的快速支援。

history.en: Appointed in 2024, he came to the USMNT after major club roles with Southampton, Tottenham, Paris Saint-Germain, Chelsea, and Espanyol.
history.zh: 他于2024年上任，此前曾执教南安普顿、托特纳姆热刺、巴黎圣日耳曼、切尔西和西班牙人等俱乐部。

note.en: Alfaro gives Paraguay a rugged, detail-heavy shape: protect the box, compete on set pieces, and counter through direct wide outlets.
note.zh: 阿尔法罗让巴拉圭呈现强硬且重细节的形态：保护禁区、争夺定位球，并通过边路直接出口反击。

history.en: He took over Paraguay in 2024 after leading Ecuador at the 2022 World Cup and Costa Rica through a transition cycle.
history.zh: 他在2024年接手巴拉圭，此前带领厄瓜多尔参加2022年世界杯，并执教哥斯达黎加经历过换代周期。

note.en: Lopetegui usually wants controlled buildup and positional patience, with Qatar trying to move opponents before attacking the final third.
note.zh: 洛佩特吉通常要求可控的后场组织和位置耐心，让卡塔尔先调动对手，再攻击前场最后三区。

history.en: A former Spain, Porto, Real Madrid, Sevilla, Wolves, and West Ham coach, he brings extensive club and international experience.
history.zh: 他曾执教西班牙队、波尔图、皇家马德里、塞维利亚、狼队和西汉姆联，拥有丰富的俱乐部和国家队经验。

note.en: Yakin's Switzerland is comfortable managing tight games, defending compactly, and using set pieces or quick counters to tilt margins.
note.zh: 雅金的瑞士队擅长处理胶着比赛，防守紧凑，并用定位球或快速反击改变细微优势。

history.en: Appointed in 2021, he led Switzerland through the 2022 World Cup and Euro 2024 while keeping a veteran core competitive.
history.zh: 他于2021年上任，带领瑞士参加2022年世界杯和2024年欧洲杯，同时保持老将核心的竞争力。

note.en: Ancelotti keeps Brazil balanced rather than frantic, trusting flexible possession, experienced game management, and individual quality between the lines.
note.zh: 安切洛蒂让巴西保持平衡而非急躁，依靠灵活控球、成熟的比赛管理，以及线间区域的个人能力。

history.en: He moved from a trophy-laden Real Madrid spell to Brazil in 2025, adding the national-team role to one of club football's deepest resumes.
history.zh: 他在2025年从收获众多冠军的皇家马德里转任巴西队主帅，为自己深厚的俱乐部履历增添国家队经历。

note.en: Ouahbi brings a development coach's lens to Morocco, pairing organized defending with quick pressing moments and faith in younger technical players.
note.zh: 瓦赫比把培养型教练视角带到摩洛哥，把有组织的防守、快速压迫时刻，以及对年轻技术型球员的信任结合起来。

history.en: Promoted after work in Morocco's youth pathway, he carries federation continuity from the country's recent international rise.
history.zh: 他在摩洛哥青训体系工作后升任主帅，延续了该国近年国际赛场崛起中的足协路线。

note.en: Migne keeps Haiti pragmatic, asking for defensive discipline first before using set pieces and quick breaks to create tournament chances.
note.zh: 米涅让海地保持务实，先要求防守纪律，再通过定位球和快速突破创造大赛机会。

history.en: He has built a broad international resume across African national teams and clubs before taking charge of Haiti.
history.zh: 在接手海地之前，他已在多支非洲国家队和俱乐部积累了广泛的国际执教履历。

note.en: Clarke's Scotland is organized and stubborn, built on back-line discipline, second-ball pressure, and quick counters from wide areas.
note.zh: 克拉克的苏格兰组织严密且韧性十足，依靠后防纪律、二点球压迫，以及从边路发起的快速反击。

history.en: Appointed in 2019, he guided Scotland back to major tournaments after successful spells with Kilmarnock and West Bromwich Albion.
history.zh: 他于2019年上任，此前在基尔马诺克和西布罗姆维奇执教成功，并带领苏格兰重返大赛舞台。

note.en: Popovic gives Australia a direct, physically secure structure, combining defensive spacing with quick pressure after turnovers.
note.zh: 波波维奇让澳大利亚拥有直接且身体对抗稳定的结构，把防守站位和失球后的快速压迫结合起来。

history.en: Appointed in 2024, the former Socceroo arrived after A-League success with Western Sydney Wanderers, Perth Glory, and Melbourne Victory.
history.zh: 这位前澳大利亚国脚于2024年上任，此前在西悉尼流浪者、珀斯光荣和墨尔本胜利取得澳超成功。

note.en: Montella's Türkiye tries to attack with rhythm, using technical midfielders, wide combinations, and pressing spells to keep opponents under stress.
note.zh: 蒙特拉的土耳其试图用节奏感进攻，依靠技术型中场、边路配合和阶段性压迫持续给对手施压。

history.en: Appointed in 2023, he came from club management in Italy and Türkiye and led the national side into a more expansive phase.
history.zh: 他于2023年上任，此前在意大利和土耳其俱乐部执教，并把国家队带入更开放的阶段。

note.en: Nagelsmann gives Germany flexible pressing and possession patterns, shifting shapes to create overloads without losing rest-defense cover.
note.zh: 纳格尔斯曼给德国带来灵活的压迫和控球模式，通过阵型变化制造人数优势，同时不丢失反击防护。

history.en: Appointed in 2023, he brought high-level Bundesliga and Champions League experience from Hoffenheim, Leipzig, and Bayern Munich.
history.zh: 他于2023年上任，带来在霍芬海姆、莱比锡和拜仁慕尼黑积累的德甲与欧冠高水平经验。

note.en: Advocaat keeps Curacao organized and practical, leaning on defensive clarity, set-piece detail, and experienced game management.
note.zh: 阿德沃卡特让库拉索保持有组织且务实，依靠清晰防守、定位球细节和老练的比赛管理。

history.en: One of international football's most traveled managers, he took charge of Curacao after long spells with clubs and national teams across Europe and beyond.
history.zh: 他是国际足坛执教足迹最广的教练之一，在欧洲及其他地区长期执教俱乐部和国家队后接手库拉索。

note.en: Koeman balances Dutch possession with set-piece threat and measured defensive structure, preferring control over constant risk.
note.zh: 科曼让荷兰队在控球、定位球威胁和稳健防守结构之间取得平衡，更偏好控制而不是持续冒险。

history.en: Back in charge since 2023, he returned to the Netherlands job after earlier national-team work and major club roles including Barcelona.
history.zh: 他自2023年重新执教荷兰队，此前已有国家队经历，并执教过巴塞罗那等重要俱乐部。

note.en: Moriyasu's Japan can control the ball or counter at speed, using disciplined spacing and direct transitions from a deep technical squad.
note.zh: 森保一的日本队既能控球，也能高速反击，依靠纪律严明的站位和技术储备深厚阵容中的直接转换。

history.en: Appointed in 2018, he led Japan at the 2022 World Cup and kept the program on a steady post-tournament path.
history.zh: 他于2018年上任，带领日本参加2022年世界杯，并让球队在赛后周期继续稳定前进。

note.en: Fae gives Cote d'Ivoire a calm counter-attacking base, prioritizing defensive balance before releasing powerful runners into space.
note.zh: 法埃为科特迪瓦建立冷静的反击基础，先确保防守平衡，再把冲击力强的跑动者释放到空间中。

history.en: Promoted during the 2023 Africa Cup of Nations, he guided Cote d'Ivoire to the title and stayed on as head coach.
history.zh: 他在2023年非洲杯期间升任主帅，带领科特迪瓦夺冠，并继续留任。

note.en: Beccacece wants Ecuador to play with intensity, pressing high when possible and using possession to create aggressive attacking angles.
note.zh: 贝卡塞塞希望厄瓜多尔踢得有强度，在条件允许时高位压迫，并用控球创造更具侵略性的进攻角度。

history.en: Appointed in 2024, he arrived after coaching spells in Argentina, Chile, Spain, and the Ecuadorian club game.
history.zh: 他于2024年上任，此前在阿根廷、智利、西班牙以及厄瓜多尔俱乐部执教。

note.en: Potter's Sweden is expected to value patient buildup, flexible attacking rotations, and wide combinations rather than pure direct play.
note.zh: 波特的瑞典预计会重视耐心组织、灵活的进攻轮转和边路配合，而不是单纯直接冲击。

history.en: Appointed after his Premier League and European club work, he brought a development-focused coaching background to Sweden.
history.zh: 他在英超和欧洲俱乐部执教后上任，把重视球员发展的执教背景带到瑞典队。

note.en: Lamouchi gives Tunisia a transition-minded setup, mixing midfield pressure with direct forward runs once possession is recovered.
note.zh: 拉穆希让突尼斯更重视攻防转换，在夺回球权后把中场压迫和直接前插结合起来。

history.en: A former France international, he has managed Cote d'Ivoire, Rennes, Nottingham Forest, Cardiff City, and several clubs in the Middle East.
history.zh: 他曾是法国国脚，执教过科特迪瓦、雷恩、诺丁汉森林、卡迪夫城以及多支中东俱乐部。

note.en: De la Fuente keeps Spain connected to its possession identity while adding vertical runners and trust in players he developed through the youth teams.
note.zh: 德拉富恩特让西班牙延续控球身份，同时加入纵向跑动者，并信任自己在青年队培养过的球员。

history.en: Promoted to the senior job in 2022, he previously led Spain's under-19, under-21, and Olympic teams.
history.zh: 他于2022年升任成年队主帅，此前执教过西班牙19岁以下、21岁以下和奥运代表队。

note.en: Bubista makes Cabo Verde hard to play through, using compact defending, counters, and set pieces to keep matches within reach.
note.zh: 布比斯塔让佛得角很难被打穿，通过紧凑防守、反击和定位球把比赛保持在可争范围内。

history.en: A former Cabo Verde international, he has led the national team since 2020 and overseen one of its strongest competitive periods.
history.zh: 他曾是佛得角国脚，自2020年起执教国家队，并带队经历队史最具竞争力的时期之一。

note.en: Garcia gives Belgium an attacking structure based on passing rhythm, wide support, and pressure from advanced midfielders.
note.zh: 加西亚让比利时的进攻结构建立在传球节奏、边路支援和前插中场的压迫之上。

history.en: Appointed in 2025, he brought club experience from Lille, Roma, Marseille, Lyon, Al Nassr, and Napoli.
history.zh: 他于2025年上任，带来在里尔、罗马、马赛、里昂、利雅得胜利和那不勒斯的俱乐部执教经验。

note.en: Hassan's Egypt is direct and emotionally intense, built around defensive security, quick counters, and set-piece pressure.
note.zh: 哈桑的埃及直接且情绪强度很高，围绕防守安全、快速反击和定位球压力来搭建。

history.en: The country's all-time leading scorer became Egypt head coach in 2024 after a long domestic managerial career.
history.zh: 这位埃及队史射手王在长期本土执教生涯后，于2024年成为埃及主教练。

note.en: Donis tends to use wide overloads and attacking rotations, asking Saudi Arabia to move quickly from buildup into the final third.
note.zh: 多尼斯倾向使用边路人数优势和进攻轮转，要求沙特阿拉伯从组织阶段快速推进到前场最后三区。

history.en: A former Greece international, he has coached clubs in Greece, Cyprus, Saudi Arabia, and the Gulf before this national-team spell.
history.zh: 他曾是希腊国脚，在执教这支国家队之前，曾在希腊、塞浦路斯、沙特阿拉伯和海湾地区俱乐部执教。

note.en: Bielsa's Uruguay plays with relentless pressing, direct running, and man-oriented intensity that can turn games into physical sprints.
note.zh: 贝尔萨的乌拉圭依靠不停歇的压迫、直接跑动和人盯人强度，能把比赛变成身体冲刺。

history.en: Appointed in 2023, he brought his influential club and international career to Uruguay after spells with Argentina, Chile, Athletic Club, Marseille, Lille, and Leeds.
history.zh: 他于2023年上任，此前执教阿根廷、智利、毕尔巴鄂竞技、马赛、里尔和利兹联，把极具影响力的俱乐部和国家队经历带到乌拉圭。

note.en: Ghalehnoy keeps Iran compact and combative, mixing defensive organization with sharp counters through experienced attackers.
note.zh: 加莱诺伊让伊朗保持紧凑且善于对抗，把有组织的防守和老练攻击手发起的锐利反击结合起来。

history.en: Back in charge since 2023, he previously managed Iran in the 2000s and built a long title-winning resume in Iranian club football.
history.zh: 他自2023年重新执教伊朗队，此前曾在2000年代执教国家队，并在伊朗俱乐部足坛积累了长期夺冠履历。

note.en: Bazeley gives New Zealand a disciplined, development-minded setup, with clear roles, organized pressing, and set-piece attention.
note.zh: 巴泽利让新西兰拥有纪律性和发展导向的体系，角色清晰、压迫有组织，并重视定位球。

history.en: Appointed in 2023, he moved up from New Zealand youth and interim roles after a long playing and coaching career in the country.
history.zh: 他于2023年上任，此前在新西兰拥有漫长的球员和教练经历，并从青年队及临时主帅岗位升任。

note.en: Deschamps keeps France ruthlessly practical: defend the center, manage momentum, and let elite transition players decide matches.
note.zh: 德尚让法国保持极其务实：守住中路、管理比赛势头，并让顶级转换球员决定比赛。

history.en: Appointed in 2012, he led France to the 2018 World Cup title, the Euro 2016 final, and the 2022 World Cup final.
history.zh: 他于2012年上任，带领法国赢得2018年世界杯，打进2016年欧洲杯决赛和2022年世界杯决赛。

note.en: Thiaw gives Senegal direct attacking energy, looking for quick service into forwards while keeping enough midfield cover behind the ball.
note.zh: 蒂亚乌给塞内加尔带来直接的进攻能量，寻找快速向前锋输送，同时在球后保留足够中场保护。

history.en: A former Senegal international, he moved through assistant and interim roles before taking over the senior national team.
history.zh: 他曾是塞内加尔国脚，在担任助教和临时主帅后接手成年国家队。

note.en: Arnold's Iraq profile is direct and competitive, using organized defending, pressing spells, and quick forward balls to unsettle opponents.
note.zh: 阿诺德麾下的伊拉克直接且有竞争力，依靠有组织的防守、阶段性压迫和快速前传打乱对手。

history.en: A former Australia head coach and A-League winner, he brings major-tournament experience from the Socceroos and Sydney FC.
history.zh: 他曾执教澳大利亚队并赢得澳超冠军，带来澳大利亚国家队和悉尼足球俱乐部时期的大赛经验。

note.en: Solbakken gives Norway a compact, counter-punching shape, using direct transitions to maximize the side's elite attacking finishers.
note.zh: 索尔巴肯让挪威形成紧凑的反击形态，通过直接转换最大化球队顶级终结者的威胁。

history.en: Appointed in 2020, he arrived after a long club career, especially with Copenhagen, and has steered Norway through multiple qualification cycles.
history.zh: 他于2020年上任，此前拥有长期俱乐部执教经历，尤其是在哥本哈根，并带领挪威走过多个预选赛周期。

note.en: Scaloni builds a compact, intelligent Argentina side that can switch from cautious possession into fast transitions and decisive forward bursts.
note.zh: 斯卡洛尼打造了一支紧凑而聪明的阿根廷队，能从谨慎控球迅速切换到快速转换和决定性的前插冲击。

history.en: Appointed in 2018, he lifted the 2021 Copa America, 2022 Finalissima, 2022 World Cup, and 2024 Copa America.
history.zh: 他于2018年上任，率队赢得2021年美洲杯、2022年欧美杯、2022年世界杯和2024年美洲杯。

note.en: Petkovic gives Algeria defensive structure and pressing discipline, with set pieces and quick wide attacks as practical routes to chances.
note.zh: 佩特科维奇让阿尔及利亚拥有防守结构和压迫纪律，并把定位球和快速边路进攻作为制造机会的务实路径。

history.en: Appointed in 2024, he previously led Switzerland from 2014 to 2021 and coached clubs including Lazio and Bordeaux.
history.zh: 他于2024年上任，此前在2014年至2021年执教瑞士，并执教过拉齐奥和波尔多等俱乐部。

note.en: Rangnick's Austria is defined by coordinated pressure, quick vertical passing, and aggressive counter-pressing after losing the ball.
note.zh: 朗尼克的奥地利以协同压迫、快速纵向传球和失球后的强势反抢为标志。

history.en: Appointed in 2022, he brought his influential pressing background from German club football and consultancy roles to Austria.
history.zh: 他于2022年上任，把自己在德国俱乐部足球和顾问岗位中形成的压迫理念带到奥地利队。

note.en: Sellami keeps Jordan organized and brave in transition, protecting central spaces before springing counters through quick support runs.
note.zh: 塞拉米让约旦保持有组织且敢于转换，先保护中路空间，再通过快速支援跑动发动反击。

history.en: A former Morocco international, he took the Jordan job in 2024 after work with Morocco's domestic and youth programs.
history.zh: 他曾是摩洛哥国脚，在摩洛哥本土和青年项目工作后，于2024年接手约旦队。

note.en: Martinez gives Portugal possession control with pragmatic tournament safeguards, letting creative attackers rotate while the back line stays protected.
note.zh: 马丁内斯让葡萄牙在控球中加入务实的大赛保护，让创造型攻击手轮转，同时保持后防线受保护。

history.en: Appointed in 2023, he came to Portugal after leading Belgium through an extended top-ranked era and the 2018 World Cup semifinals.
history.zh: 他于2023年上任，此前带领比利时长期位居高位，并打进2018年世界杯半决赛。

note.en: Desabre's DR Congo side is built for speed: compact defending, direct transitions, and aggressive forward runs once space opens.
note.zh: 德萨布尔的刚果民主共和国为速度而建：防守紧凑、转换直接，并在空间出现时积极前插。

history.en: Appointed in 2022, he arrived after extensive club and national-team work across Africa and helped DR Congo return to continental prominence.
history.zh: 他于2022年上任，此前在非洲多支俱乐部和国家队积累丰富经历，并帮助刚果民主共和国重返洲际舞台中心。

note.en: Tuchel is detail-heavy: he likes control, clear roles, counter-pressing, and patient problem-solving against packed defenses.
note.zh: 图赫尔非常重视细节：他喜欢控制、清晰角色、丢球反抢，以及面对密集防守时耐心解决问题。

history.en: Appointed England head coach in 2025, he brought Champions League-winning club experience from Chelsea plus major roles at Dortmund, PSG, and Bayern Munich.
history.zh: 他于2025年出任英格兰主教练，带来在切尔西赢得欧冠的俱乐部经验，以及执教多特蒙德、巴黎圣日耳曼和拜仁慕尼黑的履历。

note.en: Dalic gives Croatia tournament calm, trusting midfield control, compact defending, and timely counters rather than chasing every game state.
note.zh: 达利奇让克罗地亚保持大赛冷静，信任中场控制、紧凑防守和适时反击，而不是追着每个比赛状态跑。

history.en: Appointed in 2017, he led Croatia to the 2018 World Cup final, the 2022 World Cup semifinals, and the 2023 Nations League final.
history.zh: 他于2017年上任，带领克罗地亚打进2018年世界杯决赛、2022年世界杯半决赛和2023年欧国联决赛。

note.en: Queiroz gives Ghana a safety-first tournament shape, emphasizing defensive organization, compact midfield spacing, and counters from wide areas.
note.zh: 奎罗斯让加纳呈现安全优先的大赛形态，强调防守组织、紧凑的中场间距，以及从边路发起反击。

history.en: A veteran international coach, he has led Portugal, Iran, Egypt, Colombia, and South Africa, alongside major assistant and club roles.
history.zh: 他是经验丰富的国际教练，曾执教葡萄牙、伊朗、埃及、哥伦比亚和南非，也担任过重要助教和俱乐部职务。

note.en: Christiansen's Panama plays with attacking intent, using direct transitions, wide support, and quick combinations around the forwards.
note.zh: 克里斯蒂安森的巴拿马带着进攻意图比赛，使用直接转换、边路支援和锋线周围的快速配合。

history.en: Appointed in 2020, he led Panama through a strong qualification cycle after club roles in Cyprus, England, Belgium, and Spain.
history.zh: 他于2020年上任，此前在塞浦路斯、英格兰、比利时和西班牙俱乐部执教，并带领巴拿马完成强势预选赛周期。

note.en: Cannavaro's Uzbekistan is built from defensive detail, with set pieces and quick counters used to protect leads and punish mistakes.
note.zh: 卡纳瓦罗的乌兹别克斯坦建立在防守细节之上，通过定位球和快速反击保护领先并惩罚失误。

history.en: The 2006 Ballon d'Or winner moved into management after his playing career, coaching in China, Saudi Arabia, Italy, and Croatia before Uzbekistan.
history.zh: 这位2006年金球奖得主退役后转入教练岗位，在接手乌兹别克斯坦前曾在中国、沙特阿拉伯、意大利和克罗地亚执教。

note.en: Lorenzo prefers a disciplined Colombia shape built on defensive cover, compact pressing windows, and quick vertical counters from narrow zones.
note.zh: 洛伦索偏好纪律严明的哥伦比亚形态，依靠防守保护、紧凑的压迫窗口，以及从狭窄区域发起的快速纵向反击。

history.en: Appointed in 2022, he steadied Colombia after years as an assistant with the national team and coaching experience in Peru.
history.zh: 他于2022年上任，此前多年担任哥伦比亚国家队助教，并在秘鲁有执教经历，上任后稳定了球队。

note.en: Renard gives Tunisia a rugged tournament identity, emphasizing defensive organization, set pieces, and confident pressing in selected moments.
note.zh: 勒纳尔让突尼斯拥有强硬的大赛身份，强调防守组织、定位球，以及在特定时刻自信压迫。

history.en: A two-time Africa Cup of Nations winner with Zambia and Cote d'Ivoire, he brings extensive national-team experience across Africa, Asia, and Europe.
history.zh: 他曾分别带领赞比亚和科特迪瓦两夺非洲杯，拥有横跨非洲、亚洲和欧洲的丰富国家队经验。

note.en: Dalic gives Croatia tournament calm, trusting midfield control, compact defending, and timely counters rather than chasing every game state.
note.zh: 达利奇让克罗地亚保持大赛冷静，信任中场控制、紧凑防守和适时反击，而不是追着每个比赛状态跑。

history.en: This abbreviated FIFA lineup name refers to Zlatko Dalic, Croatia's head coach since 2017 and a World Cup finalist in 2018.
history.zh: 这个国际足联阵容中的缩写姓名指的是兹拉特科·达利奇，他自2017年起执教克罗地亚，并在2018年率队打进世界杯决赛。
